scope: Independent design review of the Q09/Q10 native runner briefing only; no runner/device execution, source modification, or Premium/profile claim.

scores.rationale: A single real free GCP focus-practice flow exercises the existing production option-order and disclosure paths without track switching or Premium admission. Unknown active session state is guarded. Restart sequencing must follow the existing durable-submit boundary.

finding.requirement: Q09 active-session rerender/restart preserves option and selection meaning.
finding.source: Canonical practice stores the session/order and committed attempts; its unsubmitted option selection is screen-local, and canonical practice rejects a simulation draft.
finding.action: If performing a cold process restart, do it only after a durable submit/ACK. Verify the resumed active session, committed attempt and option meaning. Do not expect or claim an unsubmitted choice survives process death.

criterionFindings.criterion: Q09 active session option order and selection meaning
criterionFindings.finding: Existing session preparation persists occurrence-keyed option order; resume validates package identity, fingerprint and order. Current tests use test storage rebind, not a native process restart. The proposed runner session supplies bounded native evidence.

criterionFindings.criterion: Q10 pre-submit disclosure and post-submit feedback
criterionFindings.finding: GCP focus practice uses fixed after-each-durable-submit feedback. Existing view-model and renderer tests cover source projection; the proposal checks real UI before and after submit. It makes no end-of-simulation feedback claim.

GCP focus practice is not listed as a Premium product mode and is scoped to the GCP free node. The lifecycle rejects starting while an active session exists. Proposal avoids track/profile changes, clearing and unknown-session mutation.
Not addressed by this slice: repaired-question correct/wrong/partial coverage, authorized Premium profile, partial denominator, Q13 live package update and full-area acceptance remain separate.

validation.reason: This task was an independent briefing/design review. Matching source tests and earlier source-review receipts were read as design evidence; the proposed actual-runner evidence must be produced by the separately authorized runtime execution.
